title: Maintaining Proper Drainage Pipe Pitch
description: Proper pipe pitch is essential for maintaining self-cleansing velocity in drainage systems. If a horizontal drain pipe lacks adequate slope, solid waste settles at the bottom of the pipe while liquids trickle past, leading to recurring blockages over time. Conversely, excessive slope can allow liquids to flow too fast, leaving heavy solids behind. Routine plumbing maintenance requires verifying that horizontal runs are securely supported with pipe hangers at regular intervals to prevent sagging, which forms low spots or belly traps. Always refer to applicable local building codes for required pitch specifications based on pipe diameter.
